d: A British journalist working in Norway finds himself hunted by the Germans when he uncovers a secret U-boat base, while the daughter of a Norwegian sea captain helps the Brits combat the Nazi menace.
Fact-based account of a British merchant marine crew's harrowing attempts to bring their crippled tanker safely to port.
British soldiers search for the spy in their midst as they plan a daring escape from a World War II POW camp.

t: Forgotten Men: The War as It Was
d: Educating the youth of 1934 about the brutal reality of warfare using contemporary film and interviews with veterans.
At Coastal Command in Southern England, an RAF pilot is suspended after possibly sinking a British sub.

Against the advice of his superiors, a foreman tries to rescue essential munitions equipment from the advancing Nazi army, with the help of a quick-witted American woman and two working-class squaddies.
An American racketeer finds friendship and romance while hiding out as a recruit in the British army.
A tribute to the people and defenders of the besieged island of Malta, centred on the pivotal role played by reconnaissance pilot Lt Peter Ross in World War II.
A group of World War II British soldiers are attacked from the air while travelling across the desolate wasteland of Libya.

Old Bill, an old First World War soldier, argues with his son Young Bill about the latter not holding down a job. Soon afterwards the Second World War breaks out and Young Bill and his father find themselves serving side by side.

During World War II Lt. Dick Stacey, a pilot, inadvertently causes another aeroplane to crash, and is consequently discharged. Luckily for Stacey, his old aircraft carrier arrives, and he's given a chance to redeem himself in battle.
